title: Active Listening (in lectures)
intent: formative · Communication & Reflection (Applying) · click through the process
statement: Stop transcribing and start listening for structure: catch the lecturer’s shape, emphasis and open questions.

steps.title: Catch the structure
steps.text: Listen for how the talk is organised — the argument, not the sentences.

steps.title: Mark the emphasis
steps.text: Note what the lecturer stresses, repeats or signposts as important.

steps.title: Note the open questions
steps.text: Write down what is left unresolved — those are your prompts to follow up.

steps.title: Capture meaning, not words
steps.text: Record ideas and links in your own words; verbatim notes crowd out thinking.

steps.title: Review and fill gaps
steps.text: Soon after, revisit the notes and close the gaps while the talk is fresh.

feedForward.text: In your next lecture, write only the structure and three emphasis points — then one question the lecturer left open.
